description:
This protocol performs P7 Adapter Ligation for the Zymo-Seq RiboFree™ Total RNA Library Prep. This protocol is meant to be run on one OT-2 in conjunction with a second OT-2 running solely Select-a-Size MagBead Clean-up Protocol.
Samples will be processed down columns and then across rows (A1, B1, C1, ... A2, B2, etc.). Thoroughly mix reagent tubes thoroughly by flicking or pipetting before starting. Briefly spin down and load onto the temperature module according to Setup below.
The user is prompted to replace tipracks mid-protocol when necessary (for > 76 samples).
Links:
 First Strand cDNA Synthesis and RiboFreeTM Universal Depletion (robot 1)
 P7 Adapter Ligation (robot 1)
 P5 Adapter Ligation (robot 1)
 Library Index PCR (robot 1)
* Select-a-Size Magbead Clean-up (robot 2)



Opentrons Thermocycler Module with NEST 96-well PCR plate, full skirt
Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2 with 4x6 aluminum block for NEST 1.5ml screwcap reagent tubes
NEST 12-channel reservoir 15ml
Opentrons P20 GEN2 single-channel pipette
Opentrons 20µl



4x6 aluminum block on temperature module (slot 1)

12-channel reservoir (slot 2)
